import pathlib,subprocess
result=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert result.returncode==0 and not result.stdout and not result.stderr,(result.returncode,result.stdout,result.stderr)
print('git diff --check: passed')
paths=subprocess.run(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z'],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.split(b'\0')
checked=[]
for raw in paths:
    if not raw: continue
    path=raw.decode()
    result=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--no-index','--check','--','/dev/null',path],capture_output=True,text=True)
    assert result.returncode in (0,1) and not result.stdout and not result.stderr,(path,result.returncode,result.stdout,result.stderr)
    checked.append(path)
print('git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z: '+str(len(checked))+' new files checked')
print('Each git diff --no-index --check -- /dev/null FILE: passed (0/1 accepted only with empty stdout/stderr; 1 denotes file addition)')
print('\n'.join(checked))
